message:
So the fix commit `1abe0c8` is NOT in the current HEAD. This means the vulnerable fuzzer code is present. The vulnerability is that when `redisFormatCommand` fails, `cmd` is not set to NULL, and the fuzzer tries to free an uninitialized pointer.

Now let me understand the exact crash mechanism. The fuzzer has:
```c
char *new_str, *cmd;
...
redisFormatCommand(&cmd, new_str);
if (cmd != NULL)
    hi_free(cmd);
```

When `redisFormatCommand` fails (returns -1), `cmd` is not set to NULL. Since `cmd` is uninitialized, it contains garbage. The `if (cmd != NULL)` check will likely pass, and `hi_free(cmd)` will be called on garbage, causing a crash.

But wait - let me check if `hi_free` is just `free` or if it does something special:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cat /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/hiredis/alloc.h && echo "---" && cat /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/hiredis/alloc.c</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
